name: require_migration_version
statements: CREATE TABLE schema_migration_new (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, checksum TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','applied','failed')), started_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(started_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.???Z'), finished_at TEXT CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.???Z'), error_message TEXT)
INSERT INTO schema_migration_new SELECT version,name,checksum,state,started_at,finished_at,error_message FROM schema_migration
DROP TABLE schema_migration
ALTER TABLE schema_migration_new RENAME TO schema_migration

name: require_comment_source_and_resolution
statements: CREATE TABLE comment_new ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, document_id INTEGER NOT NULL, local_id INTEGER NOT NULL, start_line INTEGER NOT NULL, end_line INTEGER NOT NULL, original_start_line INTEGER NOT NULL, original_end_line INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (resolved IN (0, 1)), resolved_at TEXT CHECK (resolved_at IS NULL OR resolved_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.???Z'), source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, source_text TEXT NOT NULL, stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stale IN (0, 1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (created_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.???Z'), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at GLOB '????-??-??T??:??:??.???Z'), author_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'human' CHECK (author_type IN ('human', 'bot')), resolved_by_type TEXT CHECK (resolved_by_type IN ('human', 'bot')), source_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (source_deleted IN (0, 1)), FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES comment_document(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (document_id, local_id) , CHECK ((resolved = 0 AND resolved_at IS NULL AND resolved_by_type IS NULL) OR (resolved = 1 AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_by_type IS NOT NULL)))

INSERT INTO comment_new (id,document_id,local_id,start_line,end_line,original_start_line,original_end_line,body,resolved,resolved_at,source_hash,source_text,stale,created_at,updated_at,author_type,resolved_by_type,source_deleted) SELECT id,document_id,local_id,start_line,end_line,original_start_line,original_end_line,body,resolved,resolved_at,COALESCE(source_hash,''),COALESCE(source_text,''),stale,created_at,updated_at,author_type,resolved_by_type,source_deleted FROM comment
DROP TABLE comment
ALTER TABLE comment_new RENAME TO comment
CREATE INDEX idx_comment_document_id ON comment(document_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_comment_document_start_line ON comment(document_id, start_line)

name: document_table_layout
statements: CREATE TABLE document_table_layout (document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(state)), FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES comment_document(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

name: normalize_table_layouts
statements: CREATE TABLE table_layout_migration_validation (valid INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (valid=1))
INSERT INTO table_layout_migration_validation SELECT CASE WHEN json_type(state,'$.markdown')='text' AND json_type(state,'$.tables')='array' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM document_table_layout

INSERT INTO table_layout_migration_validation SELECT CASE WHEN json_type(t.value,'$.id')='text' AND length(json_extract(t.value,'$.id'))>0 AND json_type(t.value,'$.startLine')='integer' AND json_type(t.value,'$.endLine')='integer' AND json_type(t.value,'$.columnCount')='integer' AND json_extract(t.value,'$.startLine')>=1 AND json_extract(t.value,'$.endLine')>json_extract(t.value,'$.startLine') AND json_extract(t.value,'$.columnCount') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND json_type(t.value,'$.columnWidths')='array' AND json_array_length(t.value,'$.columnWidths')<=json_extract(t.value,'$.columnCount') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM document_table_layout l,json_each(l.state,'$.tables') t

INSERT INTO table_layout_migration_validation SELECT CASE WHEN w.type IN ('integer','real') AND (w.value=0 OR w.value BETWEEN 64 AND 2000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM document_table_layout l,json_each(l.state,'$.tables') t,json_each(t.value,'$.columnWidths') w
ALTER TABLE comment_document ADD COLUMN table_layout_revision_id INTEGER REFERENCES document_revision(id)

CREATE TABLE markdown_table_layout (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(id)>0), document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES comment_document(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, start_line INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start_line>=1), end_line INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end_line>start_line), column_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(column_count BETWEEN 1 AND 1000))
CREATE INDEX idx_markdown_table_layout_document ON markdown_table_layout(document_id)

CREATE TABLE markdown_table_column_width (table_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES markdown_table_layout(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, column_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(column_index>=0), width_px REAL NOT NULL CHECK(width_px BETWEEN 64 AND 2000), PRIMARY KEY(table_id,column_index))

INSERT INTO document_revision(document_id,markdown) SELECT l.document_id,json_extract(l.state,'$.markdown') FROM document_table_layout l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_revision r WHERE r.document_id=l.document_id AND r.markdown=json_extract(l.state,'$.markdown'))

UPDATE comment_document SET table_layout_revision_id=(SELECT r.id FROM document_revision r JOIN document_table_layout l ON l.document_id=r.document_id WHERE r.document_id=comment_document.id AND r.markdown=json_extract(l.state,'$.markdown') ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE id IN (SELECT document_id FROM document_table_layout)

INSERT INTO markdown_table_layout SELECT json_extract(t.value,'$.id'),l.document_id,json_extract(t.value,'$.startLine'),json_extract(t.value,'$.endLine'),json_extract(t.value,'$.columnCount') FROM document_table_layout l,json_each(l.state,'$.tables') t

INSERT INTO markdown_table_column_width SELECT json_extract(t.value,'$.id'),CAST(w.key AS INTEGER),w.value FROM document_table_layout l,json_each(l.state,'$.tables') t,json_each(t.value,'$.columnWidths') w WHERE w.value<>0
DROP TABLE document_table_layout
DROP TABLE table_layout_migration_validation
